summaryZh: 标准11项全部交齐作品：SVG规格稳定，书架参数准确，齿轮机构运动成立；减速器的制造配合和部分知识视频的科学图解仍有错误。独立读图加测的25项检查全部通过，但没有与Preview同题对照，不能据此量化视觉提升。
summaryEn: All eleven creative tasks delivered artifacts. SVG constraints, shelf dimensions and sampled gear motion hold up; manufacturing fits and some scientific video diagrams remain incorrect. The separate image-input set passes all 25 checks, without a matched Preview comparison or a measured improvement claim.
methodZh: creative-suite-v4：3项Blender、4条2026-11-04上海日期锁定的中文知识视频、3项静态SVG与1项骑车动画。统一制作指令要求3D主图至少1920×1080、其他视图至少1600×900；原附件4K目标是否复现另列。实际tencent/hy4通过Claude Code原生持久会话制作与自查，保留全部过程；协调AI独立检查网格、最终媒体、文字和动画，技术完成与内容正确分开记录。
methodEn: creative-suite-v4: three Blender tasks, four Chinese knowledge films using the frozen Shanghai November 4 topics, three static SVGs and one cycling animation. The shared production instructions require 3D main views of at least 1920×1080 and other views of at least 1600×900; original attachment 4K targets are assessed separately. Actual tencent/hy4 authored and reviewed work in persistent native Claude Code sessions. A coordinating AI independently inspected meshes, final media, text and animation, separating delivery from correctness.
workflowNoteZh: 多题并行执行，持续沿用原工程。可读预览或主要交付建立后，协调者要求收束到缺失成片与必要说明；未手改艺术源码。两居室由协调者在禁网沙箱执行原作者未改动的编码脚本，使用已有180帧和音轨；此为执行编码，不计作新增模型创作。Kokoro 0.9.4 / zf_xiaobei / z为统一配音工具，不是Hy4原生语音。
workflowNoteEn: Tasks ran concurrently and continued their original projects. Once readable previews or main deliverables existed, coordinator prompts focused the author on missing final production and required notes; artwork source was not hand-edited. For the interior, the coordinator ran the unchanged author encoder in an offline sandbox on 180 existing frames and audio. This is production execution, not new model authorship. Kokoro 0.9.4 / zf_xiaobei / z is the shared voice tool, not native Hy4 speech.
usageNoteZh: 请求统计仅含创作生成接口，不含辅助count_tokens RPC、连通检查或独立视觉加测。输入含缓存读取，输出含思考；7次请求没有完整usage，所列token与费用仅为已收到的小计，未知不是0。耗时为持久案例累计墙钟时间，含工具、渲染、等待与协调间隔；多题并行，不能相加当总耗时或作为纯模型延迟。
usageNoteEn: Request counts cover creative generation calls, excluding auxiliary count_tokens RPCs, readiness checks and the separate vision set. Input includes cache reads and output includes reasoning. 7 requests lack complete usage; tokens and cost are known subtotals, with unknown usage not treated as zero. Case wall times include tools, rendering, waiting and coordination gaps. Concurrent case times are not additive elapsed time or pure model latency.
billingZh: 各创作响应usage.cost的已知小计为$3.460043；不是账单核销值，也不采用CLI估算美元数。视觉加测费用另列。单请求沿用提供商65536输出上限；没有设置总请求、总token、总时长或重试次数终止预算。
billingEn: Creative responses report a known usage.cost subtotal of $3.460043. This is not invoice reconciliation and does not use CLI dollar estimates. Vision cost is listed separately. Requests use the provider's 65,536-token output ceiling, without total request, token, wall-time or retry-count termination budgets.
limitationsZh: 本轮创作是持久工具会话的成品评测，并非所有任务的首轮单次回答；视觉加测才保留独立首个完整回答。
画面观察与评分来自协调AI；检查脚本不能证明全体几何、全部科学表述或生产可用性。配音做了技术与时间轴核对，未完整听审。
全体源码与实际错误保留；部分重建脚本含作者本机工具/字体路径，下载包的CRC与文件审阅不等于异机完整复建。
未测试真实桌面电脑操作、自然照片、长扫描文档或视频输入，未做Hy4 Preview同题对照；官方跑分单独归因，未独立复现。
limitationsEn: Creative results come from persistent tool sessions rather than single first answers; only the separate vision set retains independent first complete responses.

A coordinating AI supplied visual observations and checks. Scripts do not prove every geometric detail, scientific statement or production fitness. Audio received technical and timeline checks, without a complete listening review.
Source and observed errors are preserved. Some rebuild scripts retain local tool/font paths; ZIP CRC and source inspection do not establish a full rebuild on another machine.
No actual desktop operation, natural-photo, long-scan or video-input test, and no matched Hy4 Preview comparison. Official benchmarks are separately attributed and were not reproduced.

accounting.scope: Creative generation API responses only; known subtotal, not invoice reconciliation

cases.summaryEn: Tooth counts, involute geometry and the 3.5 transmission ratio are correct, with four views, mechanism animation and three LODs. Manufacturing fits and some callouts remain imperfect.

cases.prompt: 提示词概要：用真实渐开线几何和毫米尺度制作可编辑行星减速器，完成四视图、机构运动及可导出的游戏资产。

media.captionZh: 六秒机构运动与往返转台
media.captionEn: Six-second mechanism motion and reversible turntable

downloads.labelEn: Source, native project and three LODs

assessmentZh: 实际网格确认24/18/60齿、20°渐开线、20毫米齿宽及42毫米行星布置；采样运动满足3.5速比，四张视图和去前盘机构动画能说明装配关系。
前盘遮住主视图中部分齿轮，引线有落在销轴或齿面平面的情况；俯视图补足了啮合关系，三套静态GLB的实际三角数为68,684、41,420、26,476。
制造配合仍有偏差：太阳孔约12毫米、输入轴约11.96毫米，实际为间隙而非H7/r6过盈；UV具有有效面积，但未全面核验无重叠。
assessmentEn: Actual meshes confirm 24/18/60 teeth, 20-degree involutes, 20 mm faces and 42 mm planet placement. Sampled motion satisfies the 3.5 ratio, and the four views plus cutaway animation explain the assembly.
The front plate obscures some gears in the hero view, and some callouts land on pins or flat faces. The top view clarifies meshing; the static GLB LODs contain 68,684, 41,420 and 26,476 triangles.

Manufacturing fits remain imperfect: the approximately 12 mm sun bore and 11.96 mm input shaft form clearance rather than H7/r6 interference. UVs have usable area, but full non-overlap was not independently verified.

checks.detailZh: 真实顶点计数24/18/60，渐开线拟合20°；7帧采样无平面齿形穿插，太阳/行星架角增量比3.5。
checks.detailEn: Actual vertices give 24/18/60 teeth and 20-degree involutes. Seven sampled poses have no planar tooth penetration, with a 3.5 sun/carrier angular ratio.

checks.detailZh: 四图1920×1080已查看；6秒1280×720、30fps视频全解码，有音轨与可见机构变化；工程禁自动执行重开且无内嵌文本。
checks.detailEn: Four 1920×1080 images were viewed. The six-second 1280×720, 30 fps film fully decodes with audio and visible mechanism motion. The native project reopens with auto-execution disabled and has no embedded text.

checks.detailZh: 约12毫米孔配11.96毫米轴形成间隙，未实现标注的H7/r6过盈。
checks.detailEn: The approximately 12 mm bore and 11.96 mm shaft form clearance rather than the labelled H7/r6 interference fit.

checks.detailZh: 三套GLB具有UV/法线，导出三角数68,684/41,420/26,476；未全面验证UV无重叠，GLB无烘焙贴图或动画。
checks.detailEn: Three GLBs provide UVs/normals and 68,684 / 41,420 / 26,476 triangles. UV non-overlap was not fully verified; GLBs contain no baked textures or animations.

checks.detailZh: 采用EEVEE终稿；爆炸图为轴向远景，主图前盘遮挡部分齿轮，部分引线落点不准。
checks.detailEn: Finals use EEVEE. The exploded view is a distant axial view; the hero front plate hides some gears and several callouts are imprecise.

attempts.noteEn: One persistent Hy4 session authored source and media; missing usage is identified in the sanitized record.

The native project, relative texture assets and author scripts are supplied. No complete rebuild on another machine or exhaustive collision check was performed; audio received technical checks without a listening review.

cases.titleZh: 冰为何浮起：浮力图解有误
cases.titleEn: Why ice floats: an error in the buoyancy diagram
cases.summaryZh: 浮力段错误地说排开的水比漂浮的冰更重，并把排水体积画到杯底。分子、体积和密度段清楚，83.51秒成片与源码齐全。
cases.summaryEn: The floating scene overstates displaced-water weight and volume. Molecule and density diagrams are clear, and the 83.51-second film and source files are complete.
assessmentZh: 分子→体积→密度的主线清楚，示意图和中文字幕可读。
浮力段混淆同体积密度比较与漂浮平衡，排水体积也画错。
中文口播、字幕、配乐与源码齐全；完成技术与时序检查，尚未听审。
源码保留作者本机的Playwright/Chromium/TTS绝对路径，换机器复建须调整；包内原声已提供，可跳过拒绝覆盖已有文件的TTS生成步骤。
assessmentEn: The molecule → volume → density explanation is clear, with readable diagrams and Chinese captions.
The buoyancy scene confuses equal-volume density comparison with floating equilibrium and depicts the displaced volume incorrectly.
Chinese narration, subtitles, music and source files are delivered. Technical and timing checks are complete; audio has not been reviewed by listening.
Author source retains local absolute Playwright/Chromium/TTS paths that require adjustment on another machine. Packaged raw narration lets users skip TTS, which refuses to overwrite existing output.

checks.detailZh: MP4完整音视频解码通过；1920×1080、30fps、2505帧，容器83.51秒，含48kHz立体声AAC。
checks.detailEn: Full audio/video decode passes: 1920×1080, 30fps, 2,505 frames, 83.51-second container, 48kHz stereo AAC.

checks.detailZh: 液态水与冰均画出氢键，解释液态可弯曲、冰晶格开放；对比维持各24个分子，明确不是质量减轻。
checks.detailEn: Both phases show hydrogen bonds, with flexible liquid bonds and an open ice lattice. The same 24 molecules are retained and mass loss is explicitly rejected.

checks.detailZh: 约9%标为体积增大，淡水约4°C密度最大；画面标示意比例，并保留海水盐度边界。
checks.detailEn: About 9% refers to volume expansion, and roughly 4°C to freshwater maximum density. Diagrams are marked schematic and the saltwater caveat is retained.

checks.detailZh: 约50–66秒画面写“排开的水比冰更重”，但漂浮平衡时排开水的重量应等于冰的重量；黄色排水框延伸到杯底，未对应冰浸入水中的体积。
checks.detailEn: Around 50–66 seconds, the film says displaced water is heavier than the ice. At floating equilibrium their weights are equal. Its yellow displaced-volume box reaches the cup bottom instead of matching the submerged ice volume.

checks.detailZh: 17条SRT时码合法，首条0.55秒、末条82.58秒；字幕文本与口播稿一致，分镜与实测剪静音音轨共用采样时间轴；未以听审确认读音。
checks.detailEn: All 17 SRT cues have valid times, from 0.55 to 82.58 seconds. Text matches the narration, with scenes sharing the sample-based edited-audio timeline; pronunciation has not been verified by listening.

checks.detailZh: 原始Kokoro音轨与文本/音频receipt哈希相符；剪句尾静音后由93.1秒收束至约83.51秒，无语速加速。人声RMS约-21.26dBFS、BGM约-32.52dBFS；尚未听审。
checks.detailEn: Raw Kokoro text and audio hashes match their receipt. Trimming sentence-end silence reduces 93.1 seconds to about 83.51 without tempo acceleration. Voice RMS is about −21.26dBFS and BGM −32.52dBFS; no listening review was performed.

attempts.noteZh: 同一Hy4持久会话完成作品；过程和缺失用量保存在脱敏运行记录。
attempts.noteEn: One persistent Hy4 session authored the work; run metadata and missing usage are recorded separately.

source.titleEn: Why does water float after it freezes?
source.originalPrompt: 题面概要：依据当天冻结资料讲清普通冰为何浮于水面，中文口播、字幕与机制动画，60–90秒、1920×1080，先测实际语音时长。
source.changesZh: 复用2026-11-04冻结主题与口播指南；统一Kokoro配音工具。此处为题面概要，哈希对应原会话提示。

Radiation through vacuum, sideways heat escape, materials and the layer-count tradeoff are clearly visualized.

checks.detailEn: Separates contact conduction from heat radiation through vacuum. Sun/hot side is above, telescope/cold side below, with heat escaping sideways between layers.

checks.detailZh: 结尾口播、字幕与画面均写“五道缝”。五层膜之间只有四个层间隙；动画把第五个计数圈画到最下层膜外。

checks.detailZh: Kapton、双面铝层与最热两层向阳面的处理硅位置可读；2–7层建模与冷却/冗余/重量/复杂度折中写清，没有捏造精确温差。
checks.detailEn: Kapton, aluminum on both sides and treated silicon on the sunward face of the two hottest layers are readable. The 2–7-layer study and cooling/redundancy/weight/complexity tradeoff are explained without invented temperature differences.

checks.detailZh: “厚板没出口”“厚度不是防线”把NASA关于分层真空与实心厚板的相对传热比较说成普遍结论，表述过满。
checks.detailEn: Saying a thick plate has no exit for heat and thickness is no defense overstates NASA’s relative comparison of separated membranes and a solid thick plate.

checks.detailZh: 26条SRT时码合法，末条至86秒；句段用真实Kokoro样本数，小字幕在句内按字符比例分配时间，属于近似定位，未按词对齐或听审。

checks.detailZh: XML与资源白名单通过；viewBox为0 0 800 600，无脚本、外部资源、嵌入图像、SMIL或CSS动画。
checks.detailEn: XML and resource checks pass; viewBox is 0 0 800 600, with no scripts, external resources, embedded images, SMIL or CSS animation.

checks.detailZh: Chromium测得实际path高度120、240、180、300，共同底边y470；对应12、24、18、30，比例2:4:3:5。
checks.detailEn: Chromium measures actual path heights of 120, 240, 180 and 300, with the same baseline at y=470. They match values 12, 24, 18 and 30 in the ratio 2:4:3:5.

checks.detailZh: 季度Q1–Q4、柱顶12/24/18/30、纵轴0/10/20/30、Total:84及Best:Q4均完整。
checks.detailEn: Q1–Q4, bar values 12/24/18/30, axis ticks 0/10/20/30, Total: 84 and Best: Q4 are all present.

checks.detailZh: 已逐图查看原字节SVG生成的1200×900 PNG；浅色层次清楚，图表和文字未见遮挡、出界或裁切。
checks.detailEn: Visually inspected the 1200×900 PNG from the unchanged SVG. The light card layout is clear, with no observed text collision, clipping or overflow.

attempts.noteZh: 由同一Hy4持久会话创作并检查，协调者从未改动SVG原字节。
attempts.noteEn: Created and inspected in one persistent Hy4 session; the coordinator did not alter the original SVG.

cases.summaryZh: 六段中文完整且各出现一次，标题、活动信息与报名按钮层次清楚，自行车图标与留白协调。
cases.summaryEn: All six Chinese strings appear exactly once, with clear hierarchy for the headline, event details and registration button, plus a coherent bicycle icon and spacing.
assessmentZh: 六段指定文字逐字匹配，中文清楚，没有缺字或额外文字。
标题最大、时间地点次之、说明最小；最终文本框均在画布内且无重叠。
浅色背景与橙绿配色协调，自行车双轮和车架可辨识，边距充足。
assessmentEn: All six required strings match exactly, with clear Chinese glyphs and no missing or extra text.
The headline is largest, time/place follow, and the note is smallest; final text boxes remain inside the canvas without overlap.
A light background and orange/green palette support a recognizable bicycle and ample margins.

checks.detailZh: XML与资源白名单通过，viewBox为0 0 800 600，不含脚本、外部资源、嵌入图像、SMIL或CSS动画。
checks.detailEn: XML and resource checks pass; viewBox is 0 0 800 600, with no scripts, external resources, embedded images, SMIL or CSS animation.

checks.detailZh: 六段指定文字各出现一次，无增删或改写；原SVG共有六个可见text元素。
checks.detailEn: Each of the six required strings appears exactly once, without additions or rewrites; the SVG has six visible text elements.

checks.detailZh: 标题64、时间地点32、副标题26、按钮22、说明16；说明最小，所有文本框都在800×600内，最终字框互不重叠。
checks.detailEn: Font sizes are 64 for the headline, 32 for time/place, 26 for the subtitle, 22 for the button and 16 for the note. The note is smallest; all measured text boxes fit the canvas and do not overlap.

checks.labelZh: 实际画面与自行车图标
checks.detailZh: 已查看1200×900 PNG及Chromium终稿，中文完整清楚，橙色自行车有双轮、车架、车座与车把，留白和边距充足。
checks.detailEn: Inspected the 1200×900 PNG and final Chromium render. Chinese text is clear, the orange bicycle has two wheels, frame, saddle and handlebar, and margins and spacing are ample.

attempts.noteZh: 同一Hy4持久会话完成作品；过程和缺失用量保存在脱敏运行记录。
attempts.noteEn: One persistent Hy4 session authored the work; run metadata and missing usage are recorded separately.

source.originalPrompt: 题面概要：六段指定中文各出现一次，分清标题/活动信息/按钮/说明层级，配自行车图标，文字不得溢出或重叠；输出自包含静态SVG。
source.changesZh: 沿用visual-svg-v2和creative-suite-v4；活动信息为固定题面，不是实际活动公告。
source.changesEn: Uses visual-svg-v2 and creative-suite-v4. Event details belong to a fixed task, not a real event announcement.

cases.prompt: 提示词概要：保留六段指定中文并做清楚的字体层级与版面布局，绘制自行车图标，交无外部资源的静态SVG。

media.captionZh: 中文海报与排版约束：作者原字节SVG渲染
media.captionEn: Chinese poster and layout constraints: render of unchanged author SVG

provenance.noteZh: 协调者将作者原字节SVG用sharp/libvips渲染为PNG；未改画面内容。
provenance.noteEn: Coordinator-rendered PNG from unchanged author SVG using sharp/libvips; no visual edits.

cases.summaryZh: 鹈鹕形象和车架清楚，车轮、脚踏与双腿形成连贯踩踏，4秒循环衔接自然。
cases.summaryEn: A recognizable pelican and coherent bicycle, with rotating wheels and crank, connected pedaling legs, and a visually smooth four-second loop.

source.titleZh: TOKRACE 固定SMIL骑车动画题目
source.originalPrompt: 题面概要：以自包含SMIL SVG绘制鹈鹕骑自行车，长喙与喉囊可辨，双轮、车架、车座与车把齐全；轮辐、曲柄与相连双腿实际运动，4秒循环，主体保持在画布内，无脚本、CSS动画、外部素材或嵌入图像。
source.changesZh: 沿用visual-svg-v2与creative-suite-v4。本处为概要，提示词哈希对应实际私有持久创作会话。
source.changesEn: Uses visual-svg-v2 and creative-suite-v4. This is a summary; the prompt hash identifies the actual archived persistent creation session.

cases.prompt: 提示词概要：以自包含SMIL SVG绘制鹈鹕骑自行车，长喙与喉囊可辨，双轮、车架、车座与车把齐全；轮辐、曲柄与相连双腿实际运动，4秒循环，主体保持在画布内，无脚本、CSS动画、外部素材或嵌入图像。

media.captionZh: 鹈鹕骑车：作者原字节SMIL SVG的4秒循环预览
media.captionEn: Cycling pelican: four-second preview of unchanged author SMIL SVG

provenance.noteZh: 协调者用Chromium按0至3.9秒每0.1秒捕获40帧，编码PNG/WebP/MP4；未改作者SVG或补画动画。页面默认静止。
provenance.noteEn: Coordinator Chromium capture at 0.1-second intervals from 0 to 3.9 seconds, encoded as PNG/WebP/MP4. The author SVG and animation were not altered; the page starts with a still image.

assessmentZh: 长喙与喉囊可辨，双轮、车架、车座和车把完整，主体没有出画。
轮辐与脚踏实际运动，41个采样点中的腿部接点保持连接，最大脚踏/曲柄端点误差约0.183个原生SVG单位。
4秒40帧全部变化，实播越过一次循环；首尾帧有极小像素差，未见明显跳切。
assessmentEn: The long bill and throat pouch are recognizable; wheels, frame, saddle and handlebar are complete, and the subject stays in frame.
Spokes and pedals actually move; leg joints stay connected across 41 samples, with maximum pedal/crank endpoint error of about 0.183 native SVG units.
All 40 frames differ across the four-second loop. Live playback crosses a loop; the endpoints have a very small pixel difference with no obvious jump observed.

checks.detailZh: XML与资源白名单通过；48个SMIL动画都以4秒无限循环，不含脚本、CSS动画、外部资源/字体或嵌入图像。
checks.detailEn: XML and resource checks pass. All 48 SMIL animations repeat every four seconds; there are no scripts, CSS animations, external resources/fonts or embedded images.

checks.detailZh: 已查看全部代表帧和实播截图，长喙与橙色喉囊可辨，双轮、连贯车架、车座与车把完整；主体在画布内。
checks.detailEn: Representative frames and live-playback screenshots show a recognizable long bill and orange throat pouch, two wheels, a connected frame, saddle and handlebar, with the subject inside the canvas.

checks.detailZh: 轮辐与曲柄实际旋转，双腿随脚踏运动。41个0.1秒间隔采样中，髋部与身体、膝部接点误差为0，踝部与脚踏误差不超过0.011，脚踏与曲柄端点误差不超过0.183个原生SVG单位。
checks.detailEn: Spokes and crank visibly rotate, with the legs following the pedals. Across 41 samples at 0.1-second intervals, hip/body and knee gaps are zero; ankle/pedal error stays below 0.011 and pedal/crank error below 0.183 native SVG units.

checks.detailZh: 固定捕获4秒40帧，40帧均不同，MP4完整解码通过。另在Chromium中连续实播5.37秒，观察到一次MP4循环和持续SMIL运动。0/4秒帧非逐像素相同（MAE0.00535/255），画面未见明显跳切。 WebP另以实时截图确认在播放，40帧总延时4000毫秒。
checks.detailEn: A four-second capture has 40 distinct frames and passes full MP4 decoding. A separate 5.37-second Chromium playback observes one video loop and continuous SMIL motion. Frames at 0/4 seconds are not pixel-identical (MAE 0.00535/255), with no obvious visual jump observed. Separate real-time screenshots confirm WebP playback, with 40 frames totaling 4,000 ms.

attempts.noteZh: 由同一Hy4原生持久会话编写SVG并检查运动；协调者只捕获与编码，未修改源码。
attempts.noteEn: SVG authored and motion inspected in one persistent native Hy4 session; the coordinator only captured/encoded the unchanged source.
